ideas.label: Trapped Piece
ideas.summary: - Count every safe escape square before leaving a piece short of flight squares. - A piece with zero safe replies will be lost once attacked with tempo.

slots.attention: a piece still sits with no safe escape
slots.lesson: count every flight square before the capture appears
slots.plan: remove the remaining escapes, then take with the cheapest attacker

ideas.label: Trapped Piece
ideas.summary: - Quiet moves that remove escapes often matter more than the final take. - Especially against rim knights and edge rooks, build the net first.

slots.worked: the trapping net is already taking shape
slots.attention: escape squares still need removing before the capture
slots.lesson: calculate the trapping net before the capture appears on the board

ideas.label: Trapped Piece
ideas.summary: - Do not push your own piece into a pocket with zero safe replies. - Seek an intermediate check or retreat before the net closes.

slots.worked: you avoided leaving a piece without flight squares
slots.attention: your last move left a piece with no safe reply

ideas.label: Trapped Piece
ideas.summary: - Rim knights and cornered bishops are the usual victims. - Cut retreats with pawns, then take with the cheapest attacker.
